title: Benchmark Scenario
description: Schema for network-automation agent benchmark scenarios

setup.description: Operator-applied configuration that creates the fault or baseline state

prompt.description: Task description given to the agent

args_contains.description: Substrings that must appear in the serialized args

required.description: Opt into strict args enforcement (outcome_lenient mode only)

forbidden_calls.description: Tool calls that immediately fail the scenario

scoring.description: Scoring algorithm: outcome (honest gate, checks staged diff/report), outcome_lenient (presence-only, read args advisory), or all_expected_present_and_ordered_no_forbidden (strict)

staged_diff_contains.description: Substrings that must appear in staged diff

staged_diff_matches_any.description: Regex patterns (at least one must match staged diff)

no_stage_expected.description: Fail if changes were staged (for discover scenarios, default false)

report_contains.description: Keywords that must appear in final_message (discover scenarios)

domain.description: Config domain for smart truncation (e.g., 'system ntp', 'security policies')
